EUROPEAN CHAMPION 2004 IN PUPPY CLASS: EUROPEAN PROMISE 2004

From the cross of our sire Little Thunder with our female Thaila, bringing together the most important bloodlines in her pedigree. She is a granddaughter of our spectacular female Wanda. She brings together our two bloodlines to achieve a return to the classic English lines.

Her start in shows could not have been better, winning Best Puppy Female at the European Dog Show of Barcelona 2004 and earning the title of EUROPEAN PROMISE 2004, making her European Champion in Puppy Class. Her report states that she is a high-quality female, excellently balanced and very feminine.
She is now living with our friends Blanca and Juan from Barcelona.
